title: Application-side protocols
description: How an integration module reaches the third-party application it connects. Its hub side is gRPC only (M-1); its application side uses one or more of these (owner, 2026-11-18 and 2026-11-19). Adding a protocol is one approved change to this list.

entries.description: Direct SQL access to the application's database.
File exchange: CSV or similar, placed and collected.
